answer: To resist sybils each agent must forge a sequential memory-hard proof whose working set is sealed inside a non-transferable vault of private state. The proof requires a live exclusive RAM ocean that grows with the number of concurrent identities an attacker controls; clones cannot share the vault unique memory pages so a farm of n heads pays super-linear cost in both time and hardware. Honest agents reuse the same vault across epochs keeping the marginal cost low.
